Agilent 5977C GC/MSD 
The Agilent 5977C GC/MSD is a reliable instrument for routine analysis in environmental, food, chemical, petrochemical, forensic, and pharmaceutical applications. The updated HydroInert source allows for the use of hydrogen as a carrier gas, enhancing performance by reducing issues related to helium shortages and improving sensitivity and peak shape. Features like remote monitoring and email alerts make it easier to manage and maintain, improving overall efficiency and performance in the lab.
